name: Entrancing Mirrors

source.note: Compared with the published D&D Beyond chapter on 2026-10-06: https://www.dndbeyond.com/sources/dnd/au/chapter-2-spells.

summary: Up to three visible creatures save Intelligence against 7d6 Psychic and Stunned; while so Stunned, Speed is halved. Success takes half damage only. Each affected creature repeats the save at turn end to end the spell on itself.
